title: Use MarketingQueryError for dashboard card errors; Storybook needs fixed-width scenes
answers: Which component shows the error banner with retry in the marketing dashboard?
Marketing analytics story snapshot banner collapsed
How to add a story for a marketing error state
body:
Traffic and customer-card errors in the new marketing dashboard use the shared `MarketingQueryError` (products/marketing_analytics/frontend/dashboard/MarketingQueryError.tsx) instead of a bare LemonBanner. It takes `message`, `queryId` (nullable; the label is omitted when missing), `onRetry`, and `loading`.
- Table/overview/retention surfaces keep using `InsightErrorState` with a `queryId` prop.
- Stories wrap the banner in a fixed-width container (`w-[60rem] max-w-full`, and `w-[32.5rem]` for narrow) because the banner's container query collapses in snapshots otherwise (MarketingQueryError.stories.tsx).
- New stories add entries to frontend/snapshots.yml (generated hashes, do not hand-edit).
- Failure stories use mswDecorator returning 500 for `/api/environments/:team_id/query/:kind/` (MarketingQueryFailures.stories.tsx).
